newsitem.title: GERMANY: Zeitler - must keep eye on background to share rise.
newsitem.headline: Zeitler - must keep eye on background to share rise.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Franz-Christoph said on Friday the background to the recent rise in stock market prices should be taken account of.
If the driving force behind the share market rise was rising company profits, the develop should be seen positively, Zeitler said during a banking conference here.
He said the rise in share prices should not only be viewed with scepticism and that share price gains were often an indicator of positive economic developments.
Zeitler added that against the background of share price movements, the development of M3 money supply should be watched.
